headlines.title: China’s debt ratio dips as households cut borrowing and firms slash investment: report
headlines.summary:
China’s debt-to-GDP ratio fell in the second quarter for the first time since 2022, even as the government kept borrowing while households and private companies pulled back under the weight of falling home prices, sluggish income growth and shrinking profit margins, according to a new report.
The ratio slipped 1.1 percentage points to 308.2 per cent, the National Institution for Finance and Development (NIFD), a Beijing-based think tank, said in a quarterly report on Thursday.

headlines.title: 美政府建议中东地区美国公民做好撤离准备
headlines.summary: 金十数据8月2日讯，当地时间8月1日，美国国务院向身处中东地区的美国公民发出广泛安全警告，建议他们“考虑离开当地，或做好在局势升级时迅速撤离的准备”。据此前消息，美国官员透露，华盛顿正考虑最快于本周末对伊朗发动新一轮军事打击。与此同时，伊朗方面也称，将进一步打击那些允许美军驻扎军事基地的国家。美国国务院再次提醒，身处中东地区的人员应保持谨慎并提高警惕，同时做好应对航班取消、临时关闭领空以及其他旅行中断的准备。公告还强调，计划前往中东地区的美国公民应认真重新考虑自己的出行计划。

headlines.title_en: US government advises American citizens in Middle East to prepare for evacuation
headlines.summary_en: On August 1 local time, the U.S. State Department issued a broad security alert to American citizens in the Middle East, advising them to "consider leaving the area or be prepared to evacuate quickly if the situation escalates." According to earlier reports, U.S. officials said Washington is considering launching a new round of military strikes on Iran as early as this weekend. Meanwhile, Iran has said it will further strike countries hosting military bases for U.S. forces. The State Department again reminded personnel in the Middle East to remain cautious and vigilant, and to prepare for flight cancellations, temporary airspace closures, and other travel disruptions. The notice also stressed that U.S. citizens planning to travel to the Middle East should seriously reconsider their plans.——Jin Shi Data, August 2

headlines.title_en: National Healthcare Security Administration holds mid-term meeting on deepening special rectification of prominent issues in medical insurance fund management
headlines.summary_en: On July 31, the National Healthcare Security Administration, together with the Supreme People's Court, the Supreme People's Procuratorate, the Ministry of Public Security, the Ministry of Finance, the National Health Commission, the State Taxation Administration, the State Administration for Market Regulation, the National Administration of Traditional Chinese Medicine, and the National Medical Products Administration, jointly held a mid-term promotion meeting for the nationwide special rectification campaign on prominent issues in medical insurance fund management. The meeting emphasized that departments at all levels should focus on key rectification targets and diligently carry out the next phase of work. This includes using flight inspections as a key tool and leads as guidance to continue strict investigation and punishment; using innovative measures such as self-inspection and self-correction, advance reminders, and warning education to promote industry self-discipline; using refined management as a path to drive systematic governance; using the improvement of long-term mechanisms as support to strengthen both symptoms and root causes; using rectification for the people as the goal to enhance public welfare; and using departmental coordination as the focus to consolidate regulatory synergy. headlines.title: 尹志尧：中微公司5年内产能将超700亿元

headlines.title_en: Yin Zhiyao: AMEC's production capacity to exceed RMB 70 billion within 5 years
headlines.summary_en: AMEC held a ceremony today in Shanghai Lingang for the completion of its headquarters building and its 22nd anniversary celebration, formally establishing its R&D-plus-production footprint in Lingang. AMEC Chairman Yin Zhiyao revealed at the event that the company has laid out five R&D and production bases in Shanghai Lingang, Jinqiao, Nanchang, and under-construction sites in Chengdu and Guangzhou. Current total building area is 600,000 square meters, expected to grow to 900,000 square meters over the next five years or so, by which time total production capacity will exceed RMB 70 billion. (STAR Market Daily)

headlines.summary: 当地时间7月31日，美国财政部长贝森特在参加马里兰州戴维营举行的内阁会议期间表示，按照特朗普总统的指示，财政部持续对伊朗展开经济攻势，并且正在全球范围内追查伊朗资产。他还特意在特朗普面前罗列对伊朗的所谓“经济战果”：2025年3月推进相关行动后，当年年底伊朗最大民营银行宣告破产，伊朗央行被迫大量印钞，不断推高通胀，贝森特声称，如今伊朗甚至无力支付军饷。这番言论立刻引来网友质疑和吐槽。（央视）

headlines.title_en: US Treasury Secretary says hunting down Iranian assets worldwide
headlines.summary_en: On July 31 local time, U.S. Treasury Secretary Bessent said during a cabinet meeting at Camp David in Maryland that, following President Trump's instructions, the Treasury Department continues to wage an economic offensive against Iran and is pursuing Iranian assets globally. He specifically highlighted so-called "economic achievements" against Iran in front of Trump: after advancing related actions in March 2025, Iran's largest private bank declared bankruptcy by the end of that year, and the Central Bank of Iran was forced to print money heavily, pushing inflation higher. Bessent claimed that Iran now cannot even afford to pay military salaries. These remarks immediately drew questions and ridicule from netizens. (CCTV)
